name: Cold Hearth Manor
summary: Along Tirisfal’s main road, Cold Hearth Manor offers travelers a Forsaken outpost west of Brill. The farm once fed Lordaeron, but the Plague of Undeath killed its people and left the fields crawling with Scourge.

sections.title: A Chilled Hearth
sections.body: Forsaken guards hold the farmhouse at Cold Hearth Manor, west of Brill along Tirisfal’s main road. Before the Third War, the estate was known for warm hospitality and rich harvests in the heart of Lordaeron. When the Plague swept through the kingdom, the family and their laborers died and rose again as husks bound to the Scourge. Feral undead still stumble through the ruined fields, but Forsaken forces drove the mindless dead from the farmhouse. They now use it as a trading post and foothold on the road toward the eastern glades.

faq.q: What happened to the people who lived here?
faq.answer: The family and laborers who tended the estate died when the Plague of Undeath swept across Lordaeron. They rose again as mindless zombies that still haunt the surrounding fields.

faq.q: Why is it called Cold Hearth Manor?
faq.answer: The estate was once known for its warm welcome and fires. The Forsaken likely gave it the grim name as an ironic nod to its former life and the dead, blighted farm it has become.

faq.q: Who controls the manor right now?
faq.answer: The Forsaken hold the main farmhouse as a safe stop for travelers and traders on the road from Brill. Hostile Scourge still infest the surrounding fields and barns.

faq.q: Why don't the Forsaken clear out the fields?
aliases: why are there zombies in the fields
faq.answer: The Forsaken in Tirisfal Glades are stretched thin, fighting mindless Scourge remnants and Scarlet Crusade crusaders. They secure the farmhouse and main road for immediate use, while scattered dead remain in the fields as a nuisance rather than an immediate threat to Brill.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, reclaiming Cold Hearth Manor recalls their lost mortal lives. They turn former human sanctuaries into grim outposts against the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade.
The manor offers a secure waypoint on the road between Brill and Tirisfal’s eastern reaches, where travelers can pause amid the plagued countryside.
